name: B2-sharkdp__bat-when-1
answer_head: - bat has a Cargo feature `vendored-libgit2`. It is defined as `vendored-libgit2 = ["git2/vendored-libgit2"]` at `Cargo.toml:35`, so it forwards to the `git2` crate's feature, which builds libgit2 from source. The forwarding to git2's build is my inference from the definition; I did not read git2's
